entries.title: SQL 手撕总览与答题模板
entries.questionHtml:
使用说明

这份文档只整理数据库手撕题，和场景手撕分开复习。内容按由浅入深重排：先学 SQL 语义和统计题，再学索引与慢 SQL，然后进入事务、锁、日志，最后学习主从、分库分表、Outbox 和项目表设计练习。

每道题保留固定结构：问题 → 问题分析 → 必备知识点 → 答案 → 同类型/深入/关联题。SQL 题优先讲业务口径，原理题优先讲底层机制，表设计题优先讲实体关系、状态机和索引。

建议复习节奏：第一遍照目录顺序过；第二遍把每道 SQL 默写一遍；第三遍只看“同类型/深入/关联题”，训练追问扩展。

按题意选择推导顺序

  1. 先定业务口径：时间范围、是否去重、是否保留并列、是否包含 NULL。
  2. 再看表关系：主表是谁，Join 条件是什么，过滤条件在 WHERE 还是 HAVING。
  3. 写 SQL 或表结构：优先使用稳定 ID 分组，窗口函数处理 TopN/连续/排名。
  4. 补索引：按查询路径说明联合索引顺序、覆盖索引、回表和排序。
  5. 补边界：大数据量、并发更新、事务隔离、主从延迟、幂等和补偿。

  • 第二章：索引与查询优化

entries.supplementHtml:
练习：把统计口径变成可检查的结果

从口头题目到可检查的 SQL

先把问题翻译成四句：每行代表什么，保留哪些主实体，重复怎样计数，NULL 怎样处理。然后写分组键及统计量，再写连接和过滤，最后给稳定排序和最小反例。若问题只有“考了 SQL”而没有关系、数据和目标，就不能猜出唯一查询；仍可说明这个推导方法。

聚合前的额外一对多连接尤其危险。课程有两个学生和两个老师时，直接连接产生四行；订单有三条标签时，金额也可能变成三倍。DISTINCT 对恰好相同金额会错误折叠不同订单，正确做法通常是在真实事实粒度先聚合或用 EXISTS 表达只检查存在。

Java 的 ReportAggregate 对照基线与条件聚合应在同一读取契约下运行。若两次查询处于 RC 的不同语句快照，期间写入可能造成差异，即使两段算法都正确；可固定不可变样本，或由调用方建立合适的事务快照。不要为证明性能而把权限谓词或状态口径从其中一边删掉。

本章两表差异的 JDBC 示例使用 compare_a 与 compare_b。完整前置 schema 和边界数据如下；结果是值及多出的份数，不能在无身份的重复副本之间标记某个物理行。

保存为 table_diff_schema.sql。

components/data/code/table_diff_schema.sql
CREATE TABLE compare_a(business_id BIGINT,payload VARCHAR(100));
CREATE TABLE compare_b(business_id BIGINT,payload VARCHAR(100));
INSERT INTO compare_a VALUES(1,'old'),(2,NULL),(2,NULL);
INSERT INTO compare_b VALUES(1,'new'),(2,NULL),(3,'x'),(3,'x'),(4,'y');
-- B has two more rows, but five distinct value/count differences.

分组、排名与追问：独立练习数据

下列 qb_ 前缀表为独立教学模型，与其他练习表不混用。金额、工资以同币种整数单位记录，时间样例按统一时区解释；业务表的真实字段和约束仍以面试题为准。请仅在新建的练习数据库中使用，避免覆盖已有数据。查询中的问号是预编译参数，不是直接粘贴到交互式SQL客户端的变量。

ReportAggregate.java · MySQL 手册原始完整围栏
import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.TreeMap;

/** Pedagogical Java row-iteration baseline versus one conditional aggregate, same connection/snapshot. */
public final class ReportAggregate {
    private ReportAggregate() {}
    public record Totals(long count,long open,long paid,long refunded,BigDecimal paidMinor) {}
    private static final String FILTER=" FROM crm_order o WHERE o.tenant_id=? AND o.created_at>=? AND o.created_at<?"
        +" AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM department_grant g WHERE g.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND g.principal_id=? AND g.dept_id=o.dept_id)";
    private static PreparedStatement prepare(Connection c,String sql,long tenant,long start,long end,long principal) throws SQLException {
        if(tenant<=0 || principal<=0 || start>=end)throw new IllegalArgumentException();
        PreparedStatement p=c.prepareStatement(sql);
        try {p.setLong(1,tenant);p.setLong(2,start);p.setLong(3,end);p.setLong(4,principal);p.setQueryTimeout(2);return p;}
        catch(SQLException | RuntimeException e) {try {p.close();} catch(SQLException x) {if(e!=x)e.addSuppressed(x);}throw e;}
    }
    public static Map<String,Totals> javaAggregate(Connection c,long tenant,long start,long end,long principal) throws SQLException {
        Map<String,Totals> result=new TreeMap<>();
        try(PreparedStatement p=prepare(c,"SELECT o.currency,o.status,o.amount_minor"+FILTER,tenant,start,end,principal);ResultSet r=p.executeQuery()) {
            while(r.next()) {
                String currency=r.getString(1),status=r.getString(2);BigDecimal amount=r.getBigDecimal(3);
                Totals a=result.getOrDefault(currency,new Totals(0,0,0,0,BigDecimal.ZERO));
                result.put(currency,new Totals(Math.addExact(a.count(),1),Math.addExact(a.open(),status.equals("OPEN")?1:0),
                    Math.addExact(a.paid(),status.equals("PAID")?1:0),Math.addExact(a.refunded(),status.equals("REFUNDED")?1:0),
                    status.equals("PAID")?a.paidMinor().add(amount):a.paidMinor()));
            }
        }
        return result;
    }
    public static Map<String,Totals> databaseAggregate(Connection c,long tenant,long start,long end,long principal) throws SQLException {
        Map<String,Totals> result=new TreeMap<>();
        String projection="SELECT o.currency,COUNT(*),SUM(CASE WHEN o.status='OPEN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),"
          +"SUM(CASE WHEN o.status='PAID' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),SUM(CASE WHEN o.status='REFUNDED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),"
          +"SUM(CASE WHEN o.status='PAID' THEN o.amount_minor ELSE 0 END)";
        try(PreparedStatement p=prepare(c,projection+FILTER+" GROUP BY o.currency ORDER BY o.currency",tenant,start,end,principal);ResultSet r=p.executeQuery()) {
            while(r.next())result.put(r.getString(1),new Totals(r.getLong(2),r.getLong(3),r.getLong(4),r.getLong(5),r.getBigDecimal(6)));
        }
        return result;
    }
}
report_scope.sql · MySQL 手册原始完整围栏
-- One row per business order. Amount is an integer minor unit; currencies stay separate.
CREATE TABLE crm_order (
 tenant_id BIGINT NOT NULL,id BIGINT NOT NULL,dept_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
 status VARCHAR(12) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL
   CHECK(status IN ('OPEN','PAID','REFUNDED')),
 currency VARCHAR(3) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL
   CHECK(CHAR_LENGTH(currency)=3 AND ASCII(SUBSTRING(currency,1,1)) BETWEEN 65 AND 90
     AND ASCII(SUBSTRING(currency,2,1)) BETWEEN 65 AND 90
     AND ASCII(SUBSTRING(currency,3,1)) BETWEEN 65 AND 90),
 amount_minor BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK(amount_minor>=0),
 created_at BIGINT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(tenant_id,id)
);
CREATE INDEX ix_crm_report ON crm_order(tenant_id,created_at,dept_id);
-- Permissions originate from authenticated server-side authorization, never from model-supplied IDs.
CREATE TABLE department_grant (
 tenant_id BIGINT NOT NULL,principal_id BIGINT NOT NULL,role_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
 dept_id BIGINT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(tenant_id,principal_id,role_id,dept_id)
);
CREATE INDEX ix_grant_lookup ON department_grant(tenant_id,principal_id,dept_id);
-- EXISTS avoids multiplying an order when two roles grant the same department.
SELECT o.currency,COUNT(*) AS total_count,
 SUM(CASE WHEN o.status='OPEN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_count,
 SUM(CASE WHEN o.status='PAID' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paid_count,
 SUM(CASE WHEN o.status='REFUNDED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS refunded_count,
 SUM(CASE WHEN o.status='PAID' THEN o.amount_minor ELSE 0 END) AS paid_minor
FROM crm_order o
WHERE o.tenant_id=? AND o.created_at>=? AND o.created_at<?
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM department_grant g WHERE g.tenant_id=o.tenant_id
   AND g.principal_id=? AND g.dept_id=o.dept_id)
GROUP BY o.currency ORDER BY o.currency;
-- Empty scope returns no rows. Never omit the authorization predicate for an empty IN list.
-- Fresh authorization is required per request; this table is not an immutable permission snapshot.
TableDiff.java · MySQL 手册原始完整围栏
import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.Map;

/** Two-column multiset comparison. No JOIN, hashes, or NULL-sensitive NOT IN. */
public final class TableDiff {
    private TableDiff() {}
    public record Row(Long businessId, String payload) {}
    public static final String SQL = "SELECT business_id,payload,SUM(delta) AS difference FROM ("
        + "SELECT business_id,payload,-1 AS delta FROM compare_a UNION ALL "
        + "SELECT business_id,payload,1 AS delta FROM compare_b"
        + ") all_rows GROUP BY business_id,payload HAVING SUM(delta)<>0";
    /** Positive delta means B has that many extra copies; negative means A has extra. */
    public static Map<Row,Long> compare(Connection connection) throws SQLException {
        Map<Row,Long> result = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        try (PreparedStatement p = connection.prepareStatement(SQL); ResultSet r = p.executeQuery()) {
            while (r.next()) {
                long value = r.getLong(1);
                Long key = r.wasNull() ? null : value;
                result.put(new Row(key,r.getString(2)),r.getBigDecimal(3).longValueExact());
            }
        }
        return Map.copyOf(result);
    }
}

ReportAggregate.java、TableDiff.java 仅依赖 JDK 的 java.sql 接口以便编译；执行仍需 MySQL 8.4 驱动、隔离 schema 和连接。report_scope.sql 的 ? 是 JDBC 参数模板，不能直接整体交 mysql 客户端。状态/币种的二进制比较与 CHECK 约束是 Java/SQL 对照合同；金额分币聚合用 BigDecimal，币种不混加。TableDiff 按数据库实际 collation 分组，不承诺字节差；当前示例五组差为 (1,old):-1、(1,new):1、(2,NULL):-1、(3,x):2、(4,y):1。比较须在同一可信快照/水位下，调用方给输入规模、结果组数、驱动读/网络超时和内存预算；setQueryTimeout 不是所有阶段硬总期限。本次没有执行真实 SQL 或 JDBC 数据库调用。

超时实现边界：ReportAggregate 设置了两秒 JDBC statement query timeout；TableDiff 没有调用 setQueryTimeout，连接、网络、查询及遍历总预算须由其接入层另外实现并验证，不能据前者推断后者已经有硬超时。
